kashika: लिङादेशानां सीयुडागमो भवति। टकारो देशविध्यर्थः। उकार उच्चारणार्थः। पचेत, पचेयाताम्, पचेरन्। पक्षीष्ट, पक्षीयास्ताम्, पक्षीरन्॥
kashikaEnglish: सीयुट् augment for लिङ् तिङ् (placed before by ट्): पचेत, पचेयाताम्, पचेरन् (Potential, स् elided by 7.2.79). पक्षीष्ट, पक्षीयास्ताम् (Benedictive, full form).
englishFull:
लिङस्सीयुट् — The तिङ् (personal endings) of लिङ् (Potential and Benedictive) take the augment सीयुट्.

- ट् is indicatory — augment is placed before affixes (@ref[1.1.46])
- उ is for pronunciation
- Applies to Ātmanepada affixes

In Potential, स् is elided by @ref[7.2.79]; य् before consonant-initial endings is also dropped.
